errors.what: The two eyepiece rims are drawn as almost perfect circles facing the viewer, but the head is turned in three-quarter view. They should be ellipses narrowed to match the angle of the head's front face.

cards.fix: Draw the binocular eyepieces as ellipses foreshortened to match the three-quarter turn of the viewer head, so they lie on its angled front face.

errors.where: clock against the ledge it stands on
errors.what: The clock face and rim are drawn dead-on at eye level, but the ledge below is seen clearly from above with a wide top surface. The object and its ground use different camera heights.

cards.fix: Show the clock from the same slightly raised viewpoint as the ledge: tilt the face slightly away so the rim reads as a gentle ellipse with its top edge visible. Or lower the camera so the ledge top is barely visible.

errors.where: colored lenses inside the spotlight's front opening
errors.what: The yellow, red and cyan lenses are round, front-facing circles, but the front rim of the can is an ellipse tilted down-left. The lenses do not follow the angle of the surface they sit on.

cards.fix: Draw the three lenses as ellipses foreshortened and aligned to the tilted front face of the spotlight can, matching the narrowness of its rim.
